name: The Canal Quarter
description: A reading room, a local oral historian, and a community radio introduce slower public life beyond the original four places.

entities.name: The Reading Room
entities.description: A narrow volunteer-run room beside the canal, with local papers, mismatched chairs, and a noticeboard that is always slightly out of date.
entities.purpose: Give the neighborhood a quiet public place for research, talks, and chance encounters
entities.label: Reading room

entities.name: Imani Cole
entities.description: A patient oral historian who collects contradictory accounts before deciding what she believes.
entities.purpose: Record neighborhood stories and help residents trace the histories of ordinary objects
entities.label: Imani

entities.name: Community radio
entities.description: A portable radio used for interviews, notices, music, and occasional live broadcasts from the reading room.
entities.purpose: Create shared projects, public conversations, technical mishaps, and reasons to visit
entities.label: Radio
